item.title: Port St. Lucie ranked 67th most stressed city in U.S., 42nd for financial stress
item.description: Port St. Lucie is the 67th most stressed city in the United States and the 42nd most financially stressed, according to a new WalletHub study released this month.

item.title: Methamphetamine surge hits Palm Beach County as cocaine prices rise
item.description: Federal agents in Palm Beach County are reporting an unprecedented surge in methamphetamine, fueled by the rising cost of cocaine. The DEA says the problem is spreading to Treasure Coast counties.

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history with views of Atlantic and Indian River
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse, built in 1860, has guided ships along Florida's Atlantic coast for more than 165 years. The 105-step climb offers panoramic views of the ocean and rivers.

item.title: New Aldi opens in Hobe Sound as grocery prices rise 2.8% across the U.S.
item.description: A new Aldi opened Thursday at 8867 Southeast Bridge Road in Hobe Sound, giving grocery shoppers another option as food costs continue rising. item.title: Justin Bieber, Madonna to join World Cup final halftime show
item.description: Justin Bieber will join fellow headliners Madonna, Shakira and BTS at the World Cup's star-studded, Super Bowl-style halftime show, FIFA announced Wednesday.

item.title: Karolina Muchova defeats Coco Gauff at Wimbledon to reach final after dramatic tiebreaker
item.description: Karolina Muchova ended Coco Gauff's run at Wimbledon with a 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 (10) victory Thursday that ended with a drama-filled tiebreaker.

item.title: Port St. Lucie soccer stadium groundbreaking set for November at Walton & One development
item.description: Port St. Lucie SC released new renderings of its 6,000-seat stadium and announced groundbreaking is planned for November at the Walton & One development along U.S. 1 and Walton Road.
